protocol.sampling: min(cap,minimum available count across seven donors), no replacement per class
protocol.pseudo_grid_class: majority of native p>0.5 voxels, foreground iff fraction>=0.5
protocol.GT_pure_sides: foreground fraction>=.75 or <=.25; mixed excluded from class correctness only
protocol.gradient_zero: norm exactly zero; undefined cosine stored as null/mask, never fake zero
protocol.energy_weight: squared actual residual L2 per spatial location
protocol.phase_separation: all folds/all candidates sealed before any Receiver-role GT read
protocol.evaluation_order: finish D1-A/B for all 24 patches, then evaluate presealed D1-C candidates; reuse saved Oracle gradient
